description: Ground-level rolling dust displacement wave driven by a pressure source. Reads as atmospheric scale. Secondary layer for explosions, vehicle impacts, and landslides.

orchestration_stages.label: Ground Interaction Setup
orchestration_stages.description: Prepare terrain collision geometry and pressure source reference.
artistic_constraints: Ground mesh must be minimum 30m radius from epicenter.

orchestration_stages.label: Dust Source Volume
orchestration_stages.description: Define the pressure source volume that drives the dust displacement.
orchestration_hints: Source should be at ground level — Y = 0 or terrain height.
Source emits low-density high-velocity particles outward.
artistic_constraints: Source must be at or below 0.5m height.

orchestration_stages.label: Wave Propagation Simulation
orchestration_stages.description: Simulate the radial propagation of the dust wave from source outward.
orchestration_hints: Use pyro solver with high initial velocity and rapid dissipation.
Velocity field drives wave propagation — not buoyancy.
Ground constraint prevents upward movement beyond 2m initially.
artistic_constraints: Wave must hug ground — initial height maximum 2m.
Sharp leading edge — turbulence frequency minimum 4Hz at leading edge.

orchestration_stages.label: Thin Layer Ground Advection
orchestration_stages.description: Secondary thin dust layer at 0.1–0.2m height that hugs terrain surface.
orchestration_hints: Separate thin solver or low-buoyancy second pyro pass.
This layer gives the ground-hugging read on close shots.
artistic_constraints: High forward velocity — matches primary wave speed.
Color: 20% darker than primary wave dust.

orchestration_stages.label: Dissipation and Trailing Edge
orchestration_stages.description: Control the gradual trailing dissipation of the dust wave.
orchestration_hints: Trailing edge should dissipate over 60–120 frames.
No sharp cutoff — density must fade gradually.
Wind influence adds slight asymmetry to dissipation.
artistic_constraints: Final density must reach near-zero — no lingering wall of dust.

review_expectations.leading_edge: Sharp and fast. Reads as a pressure-driven physical wave.
review_expectations.ground_hugging: Wave hugs terrain — not floating. Thin layer visible at 0.1m height.
review_expectations.trailing_edge: Gradual dissipation over 60+ frames. Not a hard cutoff.
review_expectations.color: Matches terrain color — sandy/earthy. Not pure white.
review_expectations.scale: Feels atmospheric — not small or unconvincing.
